title: One-click model onboarding: screencap set and request-builder walkthrough
creator: Aisha Karim
description: Deliver a concise, developer-focused screenshot pack and micro-illustrations that demonstrate: 1) one-click model selection for Hosted API, 2) composing requests in the inline request-builder, and 3) copy-and-paste code snippets for Node/Python and curl. Assets will be used in the Getting Started guide, Quickstart modal, and API docs examples. Prioritize clarity for first-time API users and compact variants for narrow docs column widths.
acceptance_criteria: A set of 7 PNG/JPEG screenshots exported at 2x for 1200px width: model selection, request-builder default prompt, streaming toggle, function calling example, code snippet expanded, compact mobile-friendly tile, and error state with actionable CTA.
Figma file with labeled artboards, component tokens, and annotations for copy and alt text.
Inline copy vetted by PM and DevRel: short headings, a one-line microcopy for the streaming toggle, and code comments consistent across SDK examples.
Design handoff notes and final image filenames added to the ticket; links to PR and docs issue referencing these assets.
Accessibility: all images include suggested alt text and high-contrast overlays for readability in docs themes.
design_notes: Primary artboard size: 1440x768 for full-width docs hero; secondary compact: 720x380 for sidebars.
Use system font stack consistent with docs (Inter -> fallback) and 16px base for code snippets in images.
Color treatment: use brand token --rw-blue-600 for primary CTA highlights; ensure 4.5:1 contrast on overlay labels.
Show model badges: small pill with model family (e.g., redwood-3b) + performance tag (low-latency).
Request-builder stepper: show three visible fields (model, temperature, prompt) with sample prompt prefilled to match docs examples.
image_captions: Model select: choose from curated models with verified latency profiles.
Request builder: compose prompt, tune temperature, and preview token estimate.
Streaming enabled: example of a streaming response in the playground.
Function call sample: structured output and suggested schema shown in the UI.
Code snippet (Node): minimal example to hit the Hosted API with the selected model.
Compact tile: small footprint version for quick insertion into docs and emails.
